column3: “Form an alliance” renders the image of pouring a libation; “My will” renders “My spirit.”
“Backs” renders the shoulders of the donkeys.
“A witness” specifies the enduring function of the inscription.
“In the dust” and “large enough” are supplied; the Hebrew says no usable shard is found among the fragments.
“Alone” and “all” make explicit the remnant and the scope of flight.
“Teacher” renders a plural-form designation with a singular verb.
“Dense smoke” specifies the heaviness of what rises.
“Destruction” renders the word for worthlessness in the image of the sieve.
“Mighty arm” does not explicitly retain the downward movement of His arm.
